parts_and_pins.policy: Resolve parts and pins only after board-family detection, using reviewed photo-to-source links. A design BOM candidate is not an asserted installed part number when specimen revision or physical marking is unverified.

evaluation_limit: Current validation has 11 images from one physical specimen per family and no ESP32 examples. It is diagnostic and does not establish unseen-specimen accuracy.
